novel_features.name: Fleet patch posture
novel_features.description: See every endpoint across all your client organizations ranked by how many updates it is missing — one fleet-wide view.

novel_features.name: Vulnerability blast-radius (KEV triage)
novel_features.description: Rank CVEs across every organization by how many endpoints they hit, weighted by CVSS and the CISA Known-Exploited flag.

novel_features.name: Stale / dark agents
novel_features.description: Surface endpoints that have not checked in for N days, or are offline, across all organizations.

novel_features.name: Patch drift over time
novel_features.description: Diff two synced snapshots to show which updates were remediated and which newly appeared since last sync.

novel_features.name: Fleet software rollup
novel_features.description: Deduplicate installed software across the whole fleet into app name x version spread x install count.

novel_features.name: Endpoint health score
novel_features.description: A single composite score per endpoint from missing updates, open vulnerabilities, reboot-required, and staleness — fleet-ranked.

novel_features.name: Automation outcomes rollup
novel_features.description: Success and failure rates across automation instances and their per-endpoint results, aggregated across organizations.

novel_features.name: Per-client posture scorecard
novel_features.description: One row per client organization: endpoint count, missing updates, open CVEs, KEV exposure, and stale agents — the per-client posture number MSPs report to account managers.

novel_features.name: Reboot-pending sweep
novel_features.description: Every endpoint fleet-wide where an installed update is waiting on a reboot to finish — the action queue that closes out a patch cycle.
